text: Materials Science is an interdisciplinary field that explores the relationship between the structure, properties, preparation processes, and applications of materials. Its aim is to reveal the intrinsic connection between the microstructure and macroscopic properties of materials, and to design, develop, and optimize new materials to meet the functional (such as strength, conductivity, biocompatibility) and performance (such as durability, environmental friendliness) requirements of various fields. From common plastics and metals used in daily life to special alloys in the aerospace industry, semiconductor chip materials, and artificial organ materials in biomedicine, Materials Science is the "cornerstone" that supports the development of modern science and industry.
